01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol colorblind-safe palette, white-halo canvas rendering, and sparkline distribution table all show clear design intent, but at 150 lines the parallel coords is maximally dense with little visual signal.
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.encoding_integrity_note: Parallel-coord axes use data-driven d3.extent domains and sparkline histograms have a correct zero baseline, but the 24-threshold bin count is hardcoded rather than derived via Sturges' or Scott's rule, making bin widths arbitrary across different datasets.
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.stress_test_note: Both the brush ('brush end' handler fires on every pointermove) and strum (pointermove → updateSelection) trigger a full canvas redraw plus DOM data-join table update on every frame with no RAF coalescing, dirty flag, or throttle; no other interaction traps present (pointer events unify mouse/touch, no transitions risk mid-flight snap, no cross-view dispatch to cause feedback loops, and scales are static so no stale closure risk).
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.cognitive_load_note: Two-view layout (parallel coords + sparkline table) stays within working memory limits; 150 lines create density noise in the middle axes but canvas alpha-blending and the unselected-gray/selected-color contrast manage it, and the 6-color Tol palette remains distinguishable throughout.
